on_the_show: Kayla opened Episode 4 of Pain 2 Power, a double header with urologist Dr. Murray Goldberg. A Doctor of Physical Therapy on First Rehabilitation’s own staff, she talked about how personalized, one on one care changes recovery outcomes. Together the two conversations came back to one theme: taking ownership of your health.

background.text: She is a Doctor of Physical Therapy and a physical therapist at First Rehabilitation of North Palm Beach.
She brings over a decade of clinical experience in personalized, hands-on care.
